description: Who can open one site, in plain words: its previews (only people in the workspace after they sign in, or anyone with a preview's address), each part of its live site with its address (anyone, or only people in the workspace after they sign in), whether each can be switched, whether it has a pass for automated tools, and the settings page where the person sees it all. Changing it is set_site_protection; the pass is create_automation_pass, show_automation_pass and remove_automation_pass.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: get_site_protection
title: Who can open a site
